warnings.text:
This failure is a global Error, which has no _tag for a catch or a match to tell it apart by.
  Declare the failure and throw it: error Failed { message: string }, then throw new Failed({ message }).

This catch maps the failure to unknown, which tells a catch nothing about what failed.
  Return an error declaration's instance: Effect.try({ try: () => code, catch: (cause) => new Failed({ cause }) }).
